agent_summary: Implemented CBTS-939 (Set priority on a todo): added setTodoPriorityAction Server Action that validates the todoId and priority value and updates Todo.priority via Prisma, revalidating the owning list's path. Added a new TodoPrioritySelect client component (a <select> of LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH, styled per priority, auto-submitting on change via useActionState) and wired it into TodosView between the todo title and the delete button. No schema change was needed -- the Todo.priority column and Priority enum already existed in the schema.
